description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for Git's handling of CRLF and LF line endings, as well as related configuration scenarios and .gitattributes interactions.

methods.name: has_cr
methods.description: Checks if a file contains CR characters.

methods.name: munge_cr
methods.description: Adds or removes CR characters in a file in-place based on the mode ('append' or 'remove').

methods.name: cr_to_Q_no_NL
methods.description: Converts LF and CR characters in input to 'Q' based notation for testing.
